data.name: Golf Cart Lights Remain On Always
data.shortDescription: Keeps the golfcart lights on always.
data.description:
EDIT: While this mod is functional and working a superior version is now available here:

https://sotf-mods.com/mods/jojojesper/better-golfcarts

**No longer requires an extra library.**

One thing that always irritated me about golf carts is that you couldn't keep their lights on when you get out of them. This mod fixes that. Golf cart lights are now always on and you can customize how bright their light is through Mods>Configs.

**Note:** The lights will still go out if you run out of power. 

**Multiplayer:**

Client Sided. No Syncing. Collaborate with other players to have matching settings.

IMPORTANT: Lights don't stay on until you enter the golf cart first.
